sloka: केचित् क्षयनिभा देशा: केचिदुद्यानसन्निभा: ।केचिदेकशिला भान्ति पर्वतस्यास्य भामिनि ॥ २.९४.२२॥
transliteration: kecit kṣayanibhā deśā: kecidudyānasannibhā: ।kecidekaśilā bhānti parvatasyāsya bhāmini ॥ 2.94.22॥

translations.english: O lovely Sita Some regions of the mountain look like dwellingplaces, some others are like flowergardens and some are shining like a single rock.
